_note: ElevenLabs voice IDs per character folder. Never delete an id — add new ones and switch `active`. Generated lines live at episodes/<ep>/voice/<folder>/<voiceKey>/<hash>.mp3 (hash = fnv1a32 of 'speaker|text'). Editor → Audio → Voices manages this. Per-character `settings` override the global ones: speed (ElevenLabs 0.7–1.2, needs regeneration), stability/similarity/style (regeneration), tempo (ffmpeg post, no credits, 0.9–1.2), trim (post, default true), lufs (post loudness target, voice default -19; e.g. -17 = louder).
